questions.stimulusTitle: Turning an Empty Corner into a Reading Space
questions.stimulusText: (1) A narrow corner beside the school library's windows had long held two unused tables and several empty boxes. (2) The library committee decided to turn the area into a small reading space. (3) Students measured the corner and found chairs that could fit without blocking the walkway. (4) They also moved a low shelf there and filled it with short-story collections and magazines. (5) A student suggested adding a large television for video games. (6) The committee instead chose two floor lamps because the corner became dim late in the afternoon. (7) After the space opened, students began using it during lunch and before after-school activities. (8) The project showed that a useful improvement does not always require a large room or an expensive renovation.
